Quick options that work on our side (all PT):
- Wed 8/18 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 8/18 1:00–1:30pm
- Thu 8/19 9:00–9:30am

If none of those work, share a 1-hour window and we'll narrow to a 20–30 minute slot. Also, is it just you joining or will anyone from infra/product join? I can tailor the agenda.

- 5 min intros and high-level goals
- 10 min product fit (latency / cost levers)
- 5 min demo of our serving runtime and dashboard
- 5 min next steps (trial expansion or Dedicated evaluation)

Those Wed slots won't quite work; I have weekly planning then. My best window is mornings PT but with a tighter overlap: I can reliably do 9:30–10:15am PT on weekdays. Shorter is fine — 20 minutes would work if we stick to the agenda you suggested.

A couple notes so you can prep:

- Primary questions: model compatibility (open models), prefix caching behavior, and what a Dedicated setup looks like for 3x throughput.

If you can propose a single 9:30 slot that'd be easiest for me.

Samir
